STEPS.FOOT_LENGTH_DESC: Place your foot flat on a piece of paper, mark the tip of your longest toe and the back of your heel, then measure the distance between the two points.
STEPS.FOOT_TIPS_DESC: If your measurement falls between two sizes or you have wider feet, we recommend choosing 0.5 - 1 size larger for a more comfortable fit.
STEPS.COLLAR_DESC: Measure around the base of your neck, inserting one finger between the tape and neck for comfort.
STEPS.CHEST_DESC: Measure around the fullest part of your chest/bust, keeping the tape horizontal.
STEPS.SHOULDER_DESC: Measure from the edge of one shoulder across the back to the other shoulder edge.
STEPS.WAIST_DESC: Measure around the narrowest part of your waist (just above the navel), keeping the tape comfortably loose.
STEPS.HIPS_DESC: Stand with feet together and measure around the fullest part of your hips and seat.
STEPS.INSEAM_DESC: Measure along the inner seam of pants, extending from the crotch down to the ankle.

SIZE_GUIDE.FOOTNOTE: * IF YOU ARE BETWEEN SIZES, WE RECOMMEND ORDERING THE LARGER SIZE.
